ui.title: Plague of Madness - Metamagic Ready Hint
ui.patch.strict: Patch: make the Plague of Madness description accurate
ui.patch.strict.desc: By default Plague of Madness does not require the casts to be consecutive: it counts casts separately for each spell, and only a rest resets them. With this patch enabled the weapon behaves exactly as written - you must cast the same spell three times in a row, and casting any other spell resets the counter immediately. (Off by default.)
